title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Implementing the Provisions on Several Issues Concerning the Application of Law in Enterprise Bankruptcy Cases Not Yet Concluded at the Time of the Implementation of the Enterprise Bankruptcy Law of the People's Republic of China
keywords_en: bankruptcy; guarantee; enterprise bankruptcy cases not yet adjudicated at the time
full_text_en:
Notice of the Supreme People's Court on the Implementation of the Provisions on Several Issues concerning the Application of Laws to Enterprise Bankruptcy Cases That Have Not Been Concluded at the Time of the Implementation of the Enterprise Bankruptcy Law of the PRC

Fa [2007] No. 81

To the High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government, and the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

To ensure the smooth implementation of the Enterprise Bankruptcy Law of the PRC (hereinafter referred to as the Enterprise Bankruptcy Law) and the correct execution of the Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning the Application of Laws to Enterprise Bankruptcy Cases That Have Not Been Concluded at the Time of the Implementation of the Enterprise Bankruptcy Law of the PRC (hereinafter referred to as the Provisions), the following issues are hereby notified:

1. After the implementation of the Enterprise Bankruptcy Law, in enterprise bankruptcy cases that have not been concluded, civil litigation cases concerning the debtor that have commenced but have not yet been concluded shall be handled respectively in the following manners:

(1) For cases at first instance in which the debtor is the plaintiff, if the case has already been transferred to the people's court handling the bankruptcy case, the people's court handling the bankruptcy case shall continue the trial; if it has not yet been transferred, the provisions of Article 20 of the Enterprise Bankruptcy Law shall apply.

For cases at second instance in which the debtor is the plaintiff, the people's court of second instance shall continue the trial.

(2) For cases in which the debtor is the defendant, if the proceedings have already been suspended and the people's court handling the bankruptcy case has already made a ruling on the relevant dispute, the provisions of the Enterprise Bankruptcy Law shall not apply; if no ruling has yet been made, the trial shall continue in accordance with the provisions of Article 20 of the Enterprise Bankruptcy Law.

2. In accordance with the provisions of the Enterprise Bankruptcy Law, after the acceptance of a bankruptcy application, all civil lawsuits concerning the debtor may only be filed with the people's court that accepted the bankruptcy application. In enterprise bankruptcy cases that have not been concluded, if creditors or employees of the debtor, in accordance with the Enterprise Bankruptcy Law and Article 9 or Article 10 of the Provisions, file a lawsuit with the people's court, the people's court handling the bankruptcy case shall, based on the nature of the case and the internal functional division of the people's court, and in accordance with the relevant provisions of the Civil Procedure Law, have the relevant trial division conduct the trial by a single-judge panel or by forming a collegial panel.

3. For other civil lawsuits concerning the debtor, such as lawsuits for the performance of debtor contracts, lawsuits for the recovery of the debtor's external claims, lawsuits to revoke the debtor's act of disposing of property, lawsuits to confirm the invalidity of the debtor's act of disposing of property, lawsuits for the right of retrieval, lawsuits for the right of exclusion, and lawsuits for the right of set-off, the people's court handling the bankruptcy case shall handle them by analogy with the provisions of Article 2 of this Notice.

4. To ensure the smooth progress of the bankruptcy proceedings, the people's court trying civil lawsuits concerning the debtor in accordance with Articles 1, 2, and 3 of this Notice shall, within the trial period, expedite the trial of such civil lawsuits as much as possible, to avoid unnecessary damage to the rights of relevant right holders due to delays in trial.

5. For enterprise bankruptcy cases that have not been concluded, the determination of the invalidity of the debtor's acts of disposing of property shall be governed by the relevant provisions of the Enterprise Bankruptcy Law of the PRC (for Trial Implementation).

6. When people's courts try enterprise bankruptcy cases and apply Article 132 of the Enterprise Bankruptcy Law and Article 14 of the Provisions, attention shall be paid to the following issues:

(1) Article 132 of the Enterprise Bankruptcy Law applies only to employee rights and interests owed before the date of promulgation of the Enterprise Bankruptcy Law. Employee rights and interests owed after the date of promulgation of the Enterprise Bankruptcy Law are not within the scope of application of this Article. Such employee rights and interests may only be satisfied from property of the bankrupt enterprise other than that which has already been encumbered with security interests, or from property encumbered with security interests after the secured party has expressly waived the priority right to satisfaction;

(2) Employee rights and interests arising before the date of promulgation of the Enterprise Bankruptcy Law may only be satisfied from property encumbered with security interests when they cannot be satisfied according to the normal order of distribution. When the debtor still has other property available for satisfaction, satisfaction shall not first be taken from property encumbered with security interests;

(3) In the case where employee rights and interests owed before the date of promulgation of the Enterprise Bankruptcy Law are satisfied from property encumbered with security interests in accordance with the law, the bankruptcy expenses, debts of common benefit, and other rights and interests of employees that cannot be realized according to the normal order of distribution in the enterprise bankruptcy case shall not have priority over the secured party for satisfaction.

7. When people's courts try enterprise bankruptcy cases that have not been concluded, for procedures that have not yet been conducted, if the Provisions do not provide for them, in principle, the relevant provisions of the Enterprise Bankruptcy Law shall apply.

All levels of people's courts are requested to promptly report to this Court, level by level, the problems and situations encountered in the implementation of the Enterprise Bankruptcy Law and the Provisions.

May 26, 2007
